title: VP Duterte camp taps legal academic to counter unexplained wealth charge

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Vice President Sara Duterte’s defense lawyers will present a former law dean as its first witness to refute the prosecution’s claims that Duterte amassed unexplained wealth in office when her trial resumes next week. Duterte’s defense team Fortun Narvasa & Salazar law firm informed the prosecution team on Wednesday it intends to call Ralph Sarmiento as its first witness, a former dean of the University of St. La Salle College of Law in Bacolod City.
